nextTask.goal: Stop autonomous implementation and obtain explicit user gameplay approval of the final compiler-route traffic behavior before any ready/merge decision.
actions: User drives or observes civilian traffic through several junctions and verifies cars stay on lanes without visible teleport/snap.
User observes straight/right/left crossings where practical and verifies no obvious junction deadlock.
User blocks or parks near traffic and verifies cars brake, wait and recover without leaving compiler geometry.
User hijacks a traffic vehicle and verifies no duplicate/ghost vehicle and normal slot/lifecycle behavior.
User triggers police and crosses districts to verify macro police/pursuit remains functional.
User moves through streaming/camera transitions and verifies no visible traffic pop, jump or continuity regression.
acceptance: no visible lane departure, teleport, duplicate vehicle, stuck-junction pattern or police/streaming regression is reported
doNotAdvanceIf: user has not explicitly approved the gameplay checklist
any reported gameplay regression remains unexplained or unresolved
